name: rawStreamCancel
description: Cancel a rawStreamOpen stream; closes the upstream request. Also cancels an open still waiting for its head (that open fails `CANCELLED`). An id the host has not seen yet is remembered briefly, so an open that arrives after its own cancel is refused `CANCELLED`. Unknown ids succeed (idempotent).

inputs.name: streamId
inputs.description: Identifier returned by rawStreamOpen, or the caller-chosen `streamId` it was sent with.
